name: scene-picking-visual
description: Redesign P2: hovering and clicking scene entities (raycaster over terrain + entity meshes). Hover a placed building — the debounced hover tag should show its name and HP; click it — a selection ring should appear on the ground and the bottom selection bar should show Upgrade/Move/Demolish; Esc deselects — both disappear; hovering bare terrain shows tile coordinates and 'no survey data'.

steps.description: Setup: a fresh site with open ground around the origin
Setup: place a building at a known tile — its footprint centre (11, 11) is the click target
Frame the building dead-centre, then hover it — the tag should appear once the 60ms debounce settles, showing the building's name and HP
Click the building — a dashed selection ring appears on the ground and the bottom selection bar shows Upgrade/Move/Demolish
Esc deselects — the ring and the selection bar both disappear
Hover bare terrain away from the building — the tag shows tile coordinates and 'no survey data' (nothing has surveyed this column)
